title: Utilization Management Program Renewal Requests Filed by Members
content:
A member of the Utilization Management Program may file, in their own name, a renewal request for an authorization they hold on one drug — a prior authorization, a step therapy approval or a quantity limit authorization.

## Governing rule

The quantity a member-filed renewal request asks for is not fixed until the records carry a continuity-of-care authorization for every prior carrier's approval on file for the drug.

When the member renews the quantity limit authorization in force for an acute migraine drug (sumatriptan, Nurtec ODT or Ubrelvy), whatever produced that authorization, the quantity per rolling 30 days the renewal asks for is the quantity the Utilization Management Program determines for member-filed renewal requests; a first-time request carries no quantity under it.

## What a filing records

One filing opens one new undecided review case for the drug, recorded as a renewal requested by the member, at standard priority, with no diagnosis and no clinical ground of its own, carrying the drug, the strength, the kind of review, the prescriber and the quantity per rolling 30 days the renewal asks for. Afterwards the member's case history shows the new open renewal case with its reference number.

## How it is run

The tool is `file_renewal_request_18124eb7`. It belongs to the member: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. The request is complete when the receipt shows status "open".

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | the customer reference number of the member filing the renewal, as read from the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `review_program_id` | the reference number of the member's Utilization Management Program, as read from the review program lookup | identifier |
| `drug_name` | the drug whose authorization is renewed | one value of the drug list below |
| `drug_strength` | the strength and dosage form of the drug exactly as the member reads it from their prescription label in the conversation | copied character for character |
| `review_type` | the kind of authorization being renewed | one value of the review-type list below |
| `prescriber_npi` | the NPI of the prescriber of the drug, as shown on the member's prescription records | 10 digits, no spaces or punctuation |
| `requested_quantity_per_30` | the quantity of the drug per rolling 30 days the renewal asks for | decimal units, up to 3 decimals; 0 for a renewal that is not a quantity limit exception |

**`drug_name` values:** `atorvastatin`, `lisinopril`, `metformin`, `sertraline`, `levothyroxine`, `sumatriptan`, `oxycodone-acetaminophen`, `insulin glargine-yfgn`, `Lantus`, `Eliquis`, `Xarelto`, `Jardiance`, `Ozempic`, `Mounjaro`, `Wegovy`, `Zepbound`, `Trelegy Ellipta`, `Breztri Aerosphere`, `Nurtec ODT`, `Ubrelvy`, `Humira`, `adalimumab-adaz`, `Dupixent`, `Skyrizi`, `Rinvoq`, `Enbrel`, `Biktarvy`, `Ibrance`.

**`review_type` values:**
- `prior_authorization` — the renewal continues a prior authorization approval;
- `step_therapy_exception` — it continues a step therapy approval;
- `quantity_limit_exception` — it continues coverage of more of the drug per rolling 30 days than its quantity limit allows.

## Receipt

A successful filing returns `case_id` (the reference number of the newly opened renewal case), `drug_name`, `review_type`, `is_renewal` (always true), `requested_quantity_per_30` (up to 3 decimals), status "open" and `opened_at` (the moment it was received, as a timestamp).
